<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sa_pattern"><sa_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><ci_type>cmdb_ci_ip_firewall</ci_type><cpattern_type>3</cpattern_type><description/><directory>false</directory><enforce_proc_classy>false</enforce_proc_classy><invoke_per_account>false</invoke_per_account><metadata_id>5324df9c97c8d3dca4c3ba6de053afcb</metadata_id><name>Barracuda CloudGen Firewall</name><ndl>pattern {
	metadata {
		id = "5324df9c97c8d3dca4c3ba6de053afcb"
		name = "Barracuda CloudGen Firewall"
		description = "Discovery pattern for Barracuda CloudGen Firewalls"
		citype = "cmdb_ci_ip_firewall"
	}
	identification {
		name = "discovery"
		entry_point {type = "*"}
		find_process_strategy {strategy = NONE}
		step {
			name = "Get name"
			run_snmp_to_var {
				snmp_object_ids = "1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5"
				var_names = "sysName"
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
				cache_flag = 0
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set name"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].name"
				get_attr {"sysName"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Get basic info"
			comment = "iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.system.sysNamehttp://oidref.com/1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5"
			custom_operation {
				attributes {
					attribute {
						name = "required_authentication"
						value = "true"
					}
					attribute {
						name = "url"
						value = concat {
							"https://"
							get_attr {"computer_system.managementIP"}
							":8443/rest/control/v1/box/info?envelope=false"
						}
					}
					attribute {
						name = "headers"
						value = "accept: application/json"
					}
				}
				sys_id_op = "99a9f95a9f3312003cb191aec32e70e9"
				to_var_names = table {
					name = "device"
					col_names = "model","serialNumber","hostname"
				}
				parsing_strategy = custom_parsing_strategy {
					sys_id = "512a3d5a9f3312003cb191aec32e708a"
					rootXpath = "/root"
					fields {
						field {
							col_name = "model"
							xpath = "/root/model/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "serialNumber"
							xpath = "/root/serialNumber/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "hostname"
							xpath = "/root/hostname/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "forEach"
							for_each = "forEach"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
					}
				}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
				is_paginated = 0
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set serial_number"
			comment = "iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.system.sysNamehttp://oidref.com/1.3.6.1.2.1.1.5"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].serial_number"
				get_attr {"device.serialNumber"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set manufacturer"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].manufacturer"
				"Barracuda Networks, Inc."
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set model_id"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].model_id"
				eval {"javascript: var rtrn = '';
var model = ${device.model};
rtrn = model.toUpperCase();"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set model_number"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].model_number"
				eval {"javascript: var rtrn = '';
var model = ${device.model};
rtrn = model.toUpperCase();"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set can_route"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].can_route"
				"true"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set can_switch"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].can_switch"
				"true"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set can_partitionvlans"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].can_partitionvlans"
				"true"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Get interfaces"
			comment = "iso.org.dod.internet.mgmt.mib-2.interfaces.ifTable
http://iphostmonitor.com/mib/oids/rfc1213/ipForwDatagrams.html"
			custom_operation {
				attributes {
					attribute {
						name = "required_authentication"
						value = "true"
					}
					attribute {
						name = "url"
						value = concat {
							"https://"
							get_attr {"computer_system.managementIP"}
							":8443/rest/control/v1/box/net/interfaces?envelope=false"
						}
					}
					attribute {
						name = "headers"
						value = "accept: application/json"
					}
				}
				sys_id_op = "99a9f95a9f3312003cb191aec32e70e9"
				to_var_names = "SystemVariable"
				parsing_strategy = empty_strategy {}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
				is_paginated = 0
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set mac_address"
			set_attr {
				"cmdb_ci_ip_firewall[*].mac_address"
				eval {"javascript: /* The input arrives as text, parse it into an object first */
var rawText = ${SystemVariable};
var data = rawText;
var isString = typeof rawText == \"string\";
if (isString) {
    data = JSON.parse(rawText);
}

/* The management IP is passed in the same way as the JSON input */
var mgmtIp = ${computer_system.managementIP};

/* Result stays empty if no interface matches */
var foundMac = \"\";

var interfaces = data.interfaces;
var interfaceCount = interfaces.length;

for (var i = 0; i < interfaceCount; i++) {
    var iface = interfaces[i];
    var ipList = iface.ip;
    var ipCount = ipList.length;

    for (var j = 0; j < ipCount; j++) {
        var ipEntry = ipList[j];
        var address = ipEntry.address;

        /* Compare the interface address with the management IP */
        var isMatch = (address == mgmtIp);
        if (isMatch) {
            foundMac = iface.mac;
            break;
        }
    }

    /* Stop the outer loop as soon as a MAC was found */
    var alreadyFound = (foundMac != \"\");
    if (alreadyFound) {
        break;
    }
}

rtrn = foundMac;"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Transform raw interfaces table"
			set_attr {
				"interfacesJSON"
				eval {"javascript: /* The input arrives as text, parse it into an object first */
var rawText = ${SystemVariable};
var data = rawText;
var isString = typeof rawText == \"string\";
if (isString) {
    data = JSON.parse(rawText);
}
var interfaces = data.interfaces;
var count = interfaces.length;
var adapterList = [];
var seen = {};

for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    var item = interfaces[i];

    /* Skip loopback, it has an invalid MAC */
    var ifType = String(item.type);
    if (ifType == \"LOOPBACK\") {
        continue;
    }

    var ifName = String(item.name);
    var ifMac = String(item.mac);

    /* Kernel ifindex, used only as a temporary join key within this run */
    var ifIndex = String(item.index);

    /* Skip adapters that were already added, the key is the adapter name */
    var alreadySeen = seen[ifName] == true;
    if (alreadySeen) {
        continue;
    }
    seen[ifName] = true;

    /* A dot in the name marks a VLAN subinterface, e.g. eth1.30 */
    var virtualFlag = \"false\";
    var dotPosition = ifName.indexOf(\".\");
    var hasDot = dotPosition >= 0;
    if (hasDot) {
        virtualFlag = \"true\";
    }

    var adapter = {};
    adapter.name = ifName;
    adapter.mac = ifMac;
    adapter.ifIndex = ifIndex;
    adapter.virtual = virtualFlag;
    adapterList.push(adapter);
}

/* Wrap the list in an object and serialize it back to JSON text */
var wrapper = {};
wrapper.adapters = adapterList;
var jsonText = JSON.stringify(wrapper);
rtrn = jsonText;"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Parse network adapters"
			parse_var_to_var {
				from_var_name = "interfacesJSON"
				to_var_names = table {
					name = "adapters"
					col_names = "name","macAddress","virtual","ifIndex"
				}
				parsing_strategy = custom_parsing_strategy {
					sys_id = "512a3d5a9f3312003cb191aec32e708a"
					rootXpath = "/root"
					fields {
						field {
							col_name = "name"
							xpath = "/root/adapters/name/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "macAddress"
							xpath = "/root/adapters/mac/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "virtual"
							xpath = "/root/adapters/virtual/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "ifIndex"
							xpath = "/root/adapters/ifIndex/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "forEach"
							for_each = "forEach"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
					}
				}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set network adapters"
			transform {
				src_table_name = "adapters"
				target_table_name = "cmdb_ci_network_adapter"
				operation {
					set_field {
						field_name = "name"
						value = get_attr {"adapters[].name"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "mac_address"
						value = get_attr {"adapters[].macAddress"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "virtual"
						value = get_attr {"adapters[].virtual"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "cmdb_ci"
						value = get_attr {"device.serialNumber"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "correlation_id"
						value = get_attr {"adapters[].ifIndex"}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Create relationship & references"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_firewall"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_network_adapter"
				result_table_name = "adapter_to_firewall"
				unmatched_lines = keep
				relation_type = "Owns::Owned by"
				ref_direction = childToParent
				ref_field_name = "cmdb_ci"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Transform raw interfaces table"
			set_attr {
				"adressesJSON"
				eval {"javascript: /* The input arrives as text, parse it into an object first */
var rawText = ${SystemVariable};
var data = rawText;
var isString = typeof rawText == \"string\";
if (isString) {
    data = JSON.parse(rawText);
}
var interfaces = data.interfaces;
var count = interfaces.length;
var addressList = [];

for (var i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    var item = interfaces[i];

    /* Skip loopback to stay consistent with the adapter script */
    var ifType = String(item.type);
    if (ifType == \"LOOPBACK\") {
        continue;
    }

    var ifName = String(item.name);
    var ifMac = String(item.mac);

    /* Kernel ifindex, used only as a temporary join key within this run */
    var ifIndex = String(item.index);

    /* All IPv4 addresses of this adapter, the array may be empty */
    var ipList = item.ip;
    var hasIp = ipList && ipList.length > 0;
    if (hasIp) {
        var ipCount = ipList.length;
        for (var j = 0; j < ipCount; j++) {
            var ipEntry = ipList[j];
            var ipv4Object = {};
            ipv4Object.ifName = ifName;
            ipv4Object.ifIndex = ifIndex;
            ipv4Object.mac = ifMac;
            ipv4Object.family = \"4\";
            ipv4Object.address = String(ipEntry.address);
            ipv4Object.mask = String(ipEntry.netmask);
            ipv4Object.scope = \"global\";
            addressList.push(ipv4Object);
        }
    }

    /* All IPv6 addresses of this adapter, the array may be empty */
    var ip6List = item.ip6;
    var hasIp6 = ip6List && ip6List.length > 0;
    if (hasIp6) {
        var ip6Count = ip6List.length;
        for (var k = 0; k < ip6Count; k++) {
            var ip6Entry = ip6List[k];
            var ip6Address = String(ip6Entry.address);

            /* Mark link-local addresses so they can be filtered later */
            var ip6Scope = \"global\";
            var linkLocalPosition = ip6Address.indexOf(\"fe80\");
            var isLinkLocal = linkLocalPosition == 0;
            if (isLinkLocal) {
                ip6Scope = \"link-local\";
            }

            var ipv6Object = {};
            ipv6Object.ifName = ifName;
            ipv6Object.ifIndex = ifIndex;
            ipv6Object.mac = ifMac;
            ipv6Object.family = \"6\";
            ipv6Object.address = ip6Address;
            ipv6Object.mask = String(ip6Entry.netmask);
            ipv6Object.scope = ip6Scope;
            addressList.push(ipv6Object);
        }
    }
}

/* Wrap the list in an object and serialize it back to JSON text */
var wrapper = {};
wrapper.addresses = addressList;
var jsonText = JSON.stringify(wrapper);
rtrn = jsonText;"}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Parse IP addresses"
			parse_var_to_var {
				from_var_name = "adressesJSON"
				to_var_names = table {
					name = "addresses"
					col_names = "ip_address","netmask","ip_version","nic","correlation_id"
				}
				parsing_strategy = custom_parsing_strategy {
					sys_id = "512a3d5a9f3312003cb191aec32e708a"
					rootXpath = "/root"
					fields {
						field {
							col_name = "ip_address"
							xpath = "/root/addresses/address/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "netmask"
							xpath = "/root/addresses/mask/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "ip_version"
							xpath = "/root/addresses/family/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "nic"
							xpath = "/root/addresses/ifName/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "correlation_id"
							xpath = "/root/addresses/ifIndex/text()"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
						field {
							col_name = "forEach"
							for_each = "forEach"
							delimiters = ""
							position = 1
						}
					}
				}
				if_not_found_do = nop {}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Filter for IPv4 addresses"
			filter {
				src_table_name = "addresses"
				target_table_name = "ipv4Addresses"
				condition = eq {
					get_attr {"addresses[].ip_version"}
					"4"
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Filter for private IPv4 addresses"
			filter {
				src_table_name = "ipv4Addresses"
				target_table_name = "privateNetworks"
				condition = any {
					starts_with {
						"10."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.16."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.17."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.18."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.19."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.20."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.21."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.22."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.23."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.24."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.25."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.26."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.27."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.28."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.29."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.30."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"172.31."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
					starts_with {
						"192.168."
						get_attr {"ipv4Addresses[].ip_address"}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Change IPv4 prefix length into mask"
			transform {
				src_table_name = "ipv4Addresses"
				target_table_name = "ipv4Addresses"
				operation {set_field {
						field_name = "netmask"
						value = eval {"javascript: // Convert a CIDR prefix length (e.g. 24) to a dotted-decimal netmask (e.g. 255.255.255.0)

// Read the prefix length from the pattern variable and make sure it is a string
var rawValue = ${ipv4Addresses[].netmask};
var prefixText = String(rawValue);

// Parse the prefix length as a base-10 integer
var prefix = parseInt(prefixText, 10);

// Default result for invalid input
var maskString = '';

// Check that the prefix is a valid number in the range 0-32
var isNumber = !isNaN(prefix);
var isInRange = false;
if (isNumber) {
    if (prefix >= 0) {
        if (prefix <= 32) {
            isInRange = true;
        }
    }
}

if (isInRange) {
    // Build the 32-bit mask; prefix 0 is handled separately,
    // because in JavaScript \"x << 32\" behaves like \"x << 0\"
    var maskValue = 0;
    if (prefix > 0) {
        var shiftBy = 32 - prefix;
        var shifted = 0xFFFFFFFF << shiftBy;
        // Convert the signed 32-bit result to an unsigned value
        maskValue = shifted >>> 0;
    }

    // Extract the four octets
    var octet1 = (maskValue >>> 24) & 255;
    var octet2 = (maskValue >>> 16) & 255;
    var octet3 = (maskValue >>> 8) & 255;
    var octet4 = maskValue & 255;

    // Join the octets into the dotted-decimal notation
    var part1 = octet1 + '.' + octet2;
    var part2 = octet3 + '.' + octet4;
    maskString = part1 + '.' + part2;
}

// Last expression = value returned by the EVAL step
rtrn = maskString;"}
					}}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Filter for IPv6 addresses"
			filter {
				src_table_name = "addresses"
				target_table_name = "ipv6Addresses"
				condition = eq {
					get_attr {"addresses[].ip_version"}
					"6"
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set IPv4 addresses"
			union {
				table1_name = "ipv4Addresses"
				table2_name = "ipv6Addresses"
				result_table_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_address"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Create relationships & references"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_firewall"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_address"
				result_table_name = "address_to_firewall"
				unmatched_lines = keep
				relation_type = "Owns::Owned by"
				ref_direction = parentToChild
				ref_field_name = "nic"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Create references"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_network_adapter"
				key1_name = "correlation_id"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_address"
				key2_name = "correlation_id"
				result_table_name = "ip_to_nic"
				unmatched_lines = remove
				ref_direction = childToParent
				ref_field_name = "nic"
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Recalculate private IPv4 networks"
			transform {
				src_table_name = "privateNetworks"
				target_table_name = "privateNetworks"
				operation {set_field {
						field_name = "network"
						value = eval {"javascript: var rtrn;

// Values substituted by Pattern Builder (no quotes around the placeholders).
var ipAddress = ${privateNetworks[].ip_address};
var subnetBits = ${privateNetworks[].netmask};

// Normalize the inputs.
var ipText = String(ipAddress);
var prefixLength = parseInt(subnetBits, 10);

// Split the dotted address into four octet strings.
var ipParts = ipText.split('.');
var ipBinary = '';

// Convert each octet to an 8-digit binary string and append it.
for (var a = 0; a < 4; a++) {
    var octetText = ipParts[a];
    var octetNumber = parseInt(octetText, 10);
    var octetBinary = octetNumber.toString(2);
    var octetPadded = '00000000' + octetBinary;
    var octetEight = octetPadded.slice(-8);
    ipBinary += octetEight;
}

// Build the subnet mask: prefixLength ones followed by zeros, 32 characters in total.
var subnetMask = '';
for (var b = 0; b < 32; b++) {
    if (b < prefixLength) {
        subnetMask += '1';
    } else {
        subnetMask += '0';
    }
}

// Bitwise AND of address and mask, character by character.
// The '0'/'1' characters are implicitly converted to numbers by the & operator.
var networkBinary = '';
for (var c = 0; c < 32; c++) {
    var ipBit = ipBinary.charAt(c);
    var maskBit = subnetMask.charAt(c);
    var andBit = ipBit & maskBit;
    networkBinary += andBit;
}

// Convert each group of 8 bits back to a decimal octet.
var networkParts = [];
for (var d = 0; d < 32; d += 8) {
    var octetBits = networkBinary.substr(d, 8);
    var octetValue = parseInt(octetBits, 2);
    networkParts.push(octetValue);
}

// Join the octets into the final network address.
var networkAddress = networkParts.join('.');

rtrn = networkAddress;"}
					}}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Set IP networks for discovery"
			transform {
				src_table_name = "privateNetworks"
				target_table_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_network"
				operation {
					set_field {
						field_name = "subnet"
						value = concat {
							get_attr {"privateNetworks[].network"}
							"/"
							get_attr {"privateNetworks[].netmask"}
						}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "router_interface_type"
						value = eval {"javascript: var rtrn;
var interfaceType = '';
var nic = ${privateNetworks[].nic};

if (nic.includes('.')) {
  interfaceType =  'virtual';
} else {
  interfaceType =  'physical';
}

rtrn = interfaceType;"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "discover"
						value = "true"
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "state"
						value = "Processed"
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "short_description"
						value = get_attr {"privateNetworks[].nic"}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		step {
			name = "Create relationships"
			relation_reference {
				table1_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_network"
				table2_name = "cmdb_ci_ip_firewall"
				result_table_name = "network_to_firewall"
				unmatched_lines = keep
				ref_direction = parentToChild
				ref_field_name = "router"
			}
		}
	}
